artifacts.summary: Branch gates on the tableau bridge's invalid arm, fallible frame-class parsing, and the library/executable split that made both testable.

completion_data.completion_summary: The tableau bridge now emits an additive "gates" object on every invalid verdict, reporting the eight hypotheses of not_valid_of_hasOpen_int / not_validZTime_of_hasOpen_int plus their conjunction "gated", so a consumer can tell a theorem-backed refutation from a heuristic one. parseFrameClass is now fallible: it accepts Base, Dense, ZTime, Discrete and RTime and rejects anything else through the existing error path instead of silently deciding at .Base. The bridge was split into BimodalTools/TableauBridge.lean plus a 23-line executable root so the behaviour could be pinned by five new test rows in Tests/BimodalToolsTest/TableauBridgeTest.lean.

metadata.notes: scripts/check-module-invariants.sh is not clean repo-wide: C6, C23 (x2), C33 and INV fail, every finding naming only sibling task 665's uncommitted FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/WitnessFamily/*.lean modules or a FormalSystem/ file-count block. B3 passes. This task touched nothing under FormalSystem/.
